challenges.name: api-config-and-secrets
challenges.title: Wire the api's config and secrets
challenges.description: Rice Rocket's first manifest wrote the database password and the JWT secret as plain `value:` entries, and they ended up in git. The team has since created the Secret `api-secrets` out of band (keys `db-password` and `jwt-secret`); it is not in this file and must stay out of it. The editor holds `k8s/api.yaml` with its key blocks missing, each marked by a `# [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Fill every line so that: the ConfigMap `api-config` holds the settings that are not secret (`NODE_ENV=production`, `PORT=3000`, `DATABASE_HOST=db.internal.ricerocket.vn`, `DATABASE_USER=rocket`, `DATABASE_NAME=rocket`, `JWT_SECRET_FILE=/run/secrets/jwt_secret`) and every key reaches the container as a variable; `DATABASE_PASSWORD` comes from the Secret's `db-password` key; the Secret's `jwt-secret` key is the file `/run/secrets/jwt_secret`, mounted read-only, and a rotated secret reaches running pods without a restart; no secret value is written in the file. Run grades the file with a kubelet simulator that starts the api container against the cluster's Secret.
hints: Start the container in your head: for each variable and each file the api reads, which object does the kubelet take it from, and what happens when a name or key does not exist?

Look at `envFrom` with `configMapRef`, `env[].valueFrom.secretKeyRef`, a `secret` volume with `items` (`key` and `path`), and `volumeMounts` with and without `subPath`. ConfigMap `data` values are strings.

A worker that reads `REDIS_URL` from a ConfigMap `worker-config` and an API key file from the Secret `worker-secrets`: `envFrom: [{ configMapRef: { name: worker-config } }]`, a volume `{ name: keys, secret: { secretName: worker-secrets, items: [{ key: api-key, path: api_key }] } }` and `volumeMounts: [{ name: keys, mountPath: /etc/worker, readOnly: true }]` give `/etc/worker/api_key`.

tests.name: The file applies and the api container starts against the cluster's Secret
The container gets every setting from the ConfigMap and the password from the Secret
The JWT secret is the file /run/secrets/jwt_secret
No password, secret or token is written in the file
A rotated JWT secret reaches running pods without a restart
Without the Secret in the cluster the pod waits instead of running without it
